result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed; one minor visual issue found related to the discount badge on the pizza card overlapping content inconsistently with other cards.

issues.description: The '-20%' badge on the bottom pizza card uses a pill shape inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' badge style above it, though both are similar badges, the visual weight/color contrast differs slightly, causing minor inconsistency in badge styling across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge styling (color, shape, and placement) across all promotional badges for visual consistency.
